name: react-agent
title: Reason and use tools, one step at a time

origin.source: The LangGraph createReactAgent entry point, rebuilt as an explicit visible loop

comparison.purpose: Each loop the model either calls a real tool (calculator, lookup) or answers, with every step visible as machine state and a step budget that forces a best-effort answer.

starters: What is 17% of 340, and who wrote Hamlet?
Compute 128 * 47, then tell me the capital of Australia.
How many minutes are in a leap year?
